title: ModuleTaskCommand
responsibility: Expose committed feature contexts, module tasks and assigned foreground workers through the Harness CLI.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.constructor.service
inputs.description: The ModuleTaskService instance backing the registered feature, add, schema, list, show, prompt, review, retry and sync actions. When omitted, the constructor evaluates `new ModuleTaskService()`.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.register.task
inputs.description: The Commander parent command that receives the feature, add, schema, list, show, prompt, review, retry, sync and worker subcommands. It must support the command-builder methods chained by this implementation.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.register
outputs.description: Synchronous completion after attaching the CLI subcommands and their actions to the supplied parent command; it returns no value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The add action throws when the decoded task input text exceeds 1,000,000 characters, and the worker action throws when both `--once` and `--watch` are set. Registered actions can also reject when file reading, JSON parsing or a service call fails.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.register.task
inputs.description: The Commander parent command that receives the feature, add, schema, list, show, prompt, review, retry, sync and worker subcommands. It must support the command-builder methods chained by this implementation.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.register
outputs.description: Synchronous completion after attaching the CLI subcommands and their actions to the supplied parent command; it returns no value.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.constructor.service
inputs.description: The ModuleTaskService instance backing the registered feature, add, schema, list, show, prompt, review, retry and sync actions. When omitted, the constructor evaluates `new ModuleTaskService()`.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskCommand.constructor
outputs.description: The constructed ModuleTaskCommand instance used to register CLI commands. It stores the provided service or the instance created by `new ModuleTaskService()`.
